messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock scope for the observability pilot we hand to 3 pilot customers. Candidate MVP items: dashboards (cost + error), a lightweight tracing hook, cost breakdown per-route, error analytics (top traces), and alerting. Can we do this in ~6 sprints? Need concrete asks for the roadmap doc.

Ainsley (Eng): 6 sprints is tight but doable if we cut scope. Dashboards + basic cost metrics + top error table = ✅. Full span ingestion + span search is risky. Proposal: MVP tracing = trace-id propagation + span-count metrics + minimal ingestion. Full spans and searchable traces in v2.

Raj (SRE): +1 to conservative approach. Important guardrails: default sampling 0.1, dynamic override per-route. If we enable full spans without sampling we’ll see ~3x ingestion throughput. Also require fail-open behaviour so customer requests never block on trace ingestion.

Taylor (Data): For cost breakdown we can attribute tokens to route/model with the existing pipeline. Two decisions needed from product: canonical "route" dimension (route path vs API key tag) and retention window (30d vs 90d). 30d is much cheaper.

Olivia (CS): Pilot customers (FinHealth, EduModel, ShopAlpha) prefer 90d for auditability. FinHealth specifically flagged PII/redaction controls on traces as mandatory for any trace-level export.

Ainsley (Eng): PII redaction at span-level adds significant complexity. We can support a sanitizer ruleset (regex + header-based flags), but that's a follow-up. For MVP we should offer a documented manual redaction checklist and deny-list export for spans.

Maya (PM): Proposed launch criteria (draft):
1) Dashboards: cost by route/model, error rate time series, top-10 error list.
2) Tracing hook: trace-id propagation + span-count and sampled-span metric.
3) Cost: per-1k-token cost estimate surfaced on route view.
4) CS signoff from at least two pilot customers after onboarding.
Are we comfortable with that?

Raj (SRE): Add platform SLO: ingestion path must not exceed 2x baseline CPU at pilot load. Also require an explicit fail-open spec: if trace backend is unavailable, requests proceed and we emit a negative metric and a log line.

Ainsley (Eng): Agree. Fallback plan: buffer up to 50MB per pod for spans; if exceeded drop non-critical spans and emit counters. We'll document buffer sizing and backpressure behaviour.

Maya (PM): Prioritization (must vs nice):
- Must-have: dashboards (cost + errors), cost attribution, trace-id propagation, onboarding docs for pilots.
- Nice-to-have: span-level error search, PII sanitizer, route-level dynamic sampling UI.

Taylor (Data): Sampling config example we can implement quickly:```json
{"default_rate":0.1,"routes":{"/v1/generate":0.5}}```
We'll expose that as a JSON blob per-tenant in the config service.

Olivia (CS): I'll draft onboarding templates. I can get FinHealth to accept 30d retention for the initial pilot if we provide a strict PII redaction checklist and a roadmap commit for 90d + sanitizer.

Ainsley (Eng): Proposed sprint plan (high level):
Sprint 1: spec + ingestion schema + trace header;
Sprint 2: cost attribution pipeline + sample config;
Sprint 3: dashboards alpha (cost + top errors);
Sprint 4: sampling controls + retention config;
Sprint 5: CS docs + pilot onboarding;
Sprint 6: polish + canary and mitigations.

Maya (PM): Action items: @Ainsley write a short spec for the "minimal trace hook" by EOD Friday; @Taylor estimate infra delta for 30d vs 90d retention by next Wed; @Olivia confirm retention constraints with FinHealth; @Raj define fail-open behaviour and buffer sizing. I'll add these to the roadmap tracker.

Raj (SRE): Will do. Also recommend an alert rule: if ingestion 99th pct latency spikes > 200ms for >5m, page oncall.

Ainsley (Eng): FYI prototype header we'll land: `X-Redwood-Trace: <trace-id>:<span-id>`. I'll also add a tiny SDK helper to inject.

deploy-bot: prod-deploy requested by @Ainsley for branch `obs/proto-trace` at 2026-03-23T14:12:00Z — canary started in product env.

Maya (PM): Thanks — if no objections we commit this scope and move span-search and PII sanitizer to backlog. :thumbsup:
